preconditions.description: The number of skewers n is a positive integer within the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The permutation p is a list of integers of length n, where each element is between 1 and n, and all elements are unique (i.e., a valid permutation).

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(x in {0, 1} for x in b)
preconditions.description: The sequence b is a list of binary values (0 or 1) of length n.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum total number of changes required to the permutation p and sequence b.

postconditions.expression: all(2 * n in {len(set(trace)) for trace in traces} for traces in generate_traces(p, b))
postconditions.description: The output corresponds to a solution where every skewer visits each of the 2n placements (n positions × 2 directions) after some integer k ≥ 2n seconds, where traces are generated by applying the permutation p and flipping b iteratively.
The output is the minimum total number of changes required to make the permutation p and sequence b satisfy the condition that every skewer visits each of the 2n placements.
